formulas.formula: Invoices, payments, hours and tax money for your freelance business.
Setup: your name, the year, how much to set aside for taxes, your usual payment terms and an income goal.
Clients: each client with their hourly rate and payment terms.
Invoices: one row per invoice. Hours x rate = amount. Blank rate = the client's rate. Add the paid date when money lands.
Time Log: track hours. Tick Billable and Invoiced so you can see work you haven't billed yet.
Expenses, Monthly, Quarterly Taxes and Dashboard turn it all into profit and tax money to set aside.
Leave Hours blank and put the full price in Rate.
Type what arrived in Amount paid. Leave it blank when the whole invoice is paid.
Income counts in the month the money arrived, like most freelancers file taxes.
A rough share of profit for income and self-employment tax. Ask a tax pro for your real rate.
Here's to on-time payments and great clients.
